description: Implementation of the SoftOMXComponent class, a wrapper for OMX components in Android's media framework, including constructor, destructor, method wrappers, and default method implementations.

classes.name: SoftOMXComponent
classes.description: A class that wraps OMX component functionality, providing default implementations and callback handling.

methods.name: SoftOMXComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing OMX component structure and callback functions.

methods.name: ~SoftOMXComponent
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up allocated OMX component.

methods.name: setLibHandle
methods.description: Sets the library handle for dynamic loading.

methods.name: libHandle
methods.description: Returns the stored library handle.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks initialization status, default returns OMX_ErrorNone.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the component's name.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Triggers an event callback.

methods.name: notifyEmptyBufferDone
methods.description: Notifies that an input buffer has been emptied.

methods.name: notifyFillBufferDone
methods.description: Notifies that an output buffer has been filled.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Default implementation for sending commands, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Default implementation for getting parameters, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Default implementation for setting parameters, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Default implementation for getting config, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Default implementation for setting config, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: getExtensionIndex
methods.description: Default implementation for getting extension index, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: useBuffer
methods.description: Default implementation for using buffer, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: allocateBuffer
methods.description: Default implementation for allocating buffer, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: freeBuffer
methods.description: Default implementation for freeing buffer, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: emptyThisBuffer
methods.description: Default implementation for emptying buffer, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: fillThisBuffer
methods.description: Default implementation for filling buffer, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Default implementation for getting state, returns OMX_ErrorUndefined.
